---
name: Hardware report
about: Share how a board, montage or electrode setup behaved

---

**Board and firmware** (exact model, revision, firmware if known)

**Montage** (pin → site for every lead, CN switch, REF placement)

**Electrodes** (type, fresh or reused, skin preparation)

**Power** (battery only? anything plugged in nearby?)

**What the app showed** (rate, missing samples, raw flags, 50 Hz share)

**What you think it means** — label it as your interpretation.

Please share numbers or screenshots, not raw recordings.
